intro: Hezrul Bloodmark is a mission assigned by the orc veteran Regthar Deathgate to eliminate the overall warlord of the Kolkar centaur in the Barrens. By claiming Hezrul's head at the Lushwater Oasis, the Horde aims to shatter the invaders' command hierarchy once and for all.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens. He is fierce, brutal and cunning. Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.
So kill him. As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.
He leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I commend you, friend. These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless. In defeating them, your valor is proven.
